description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to a compositor client, including display, surface, keyboard, pointer, wheel, and touch panel abstractions, with licensing and environment configuration handling.

classes.name: IDisplay
classes.description: Interface for display management in the compositor, including surface creation, environment info, and native display access.

classes.name: IDisplay::ISurface
classes.description: Interface representing a drawable surface with methods for rendering, resizing, and retrieving native window info.

classes.name: IDisplay::ISurface::ICallback
classes.description: Callback interface for surface rendering and publication events.

classes.name: IDisplay::ITouchPanel
classes.description: Interface for touch panel input handling.

methods.name: SuggestedName
methods.description: Extracts a suggested display name from the CLIENT_IDENTIFIER environment variable.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Extracts additional configuration info from the CLIENT_IDENTIFIER environment variable.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an instance of IDisplay based on a given name.
